title: Versatile well made, attractive pie dish!
text: Versatile well made, attractive pie dish!. I have used this pie dish several times since I have received it. First, I just made a couple of apple pies last week and one of them was in this beautiful red ceramic dish. I also used it when making a chicken pot pie last Sunday. I had friends over and several recommended what an attractive dish this is. Almost all my countertop accessories are red, so this pie dish blended right in. Quality made, relatively heavy and super easy to clean. This would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift, or just to treat yourself. Highly recommend.
